name: BOMESC Offshore Engineering Company Limited
summary: BOMESC Offshore Engineering Company Limited provides engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services for offshore oil and gas industries. The company provides design and construction EPC services for electronic modules, life modules, chemical injection modules, sledges, ocean engineering modules, and modules used in LNG mining, refinery, and chemical plants. It also engages in the resource fabrication yard, project management, design, and procurement activities.
